name: Ultimate Guitar Tabs
author: Carmine Paolino
description: Shows the Ultimate Guitar tab for whatever is playing. Reads the track from MPRIS, picks the best-rated tab for it, and renders it in the bar with auto-scroll, a version switcher, and text sizing.

barWidget.description: The tab for the song that is playing, with auto-scroll and a version switcher.

schema.label: Preferred tab type
schema.description: Which kind of tab to open first when a song has several. The other kinds stay available in the version switcher.

schema.label: Expanded width (% of screen)
schema.description: How wide the reader grows when expanded with the button in its header. It always opens compact.

schema.label: Expanded height (% of screen)
schema.description: The tallest the reader may grow when expanded. Short tabs still shrink the panel to fit.

schema.label: Hide when nothing is playing
schema.description: Keep the bar clear until a player reports a track.
